description: This Java class functions as a REST controller for managing 'Question' entities in a Spring Boot application. It provides endpoints for CRUD operations (Create, Read, Update, Delete) with support for pagination, and uses Swagger annotations for API documentation.

classes.name: QuestionController
classes.description: REST controller managing questions with CRUD operations and pagination.

methods.name: getQuestions
methods.description: Retrieves a paginated list of all questions.

methods.name: updateQuestion
methods.description: Updates an existing question identified by its ID.

methods.name: deleteQuestion
methods.description: Deletes a question specified by its ID.
